## Why Use Ecwid API?

**Get Started Easily**
Simple and intuitive API to make development a piece of cake.

**Ecwid Developer Community**
Ask questions about the Ecwid API and talk to other developers in our Slack team.

**Customize Anything**
Customize any aspect of your store to fit your business needs.

**We Are Here to Help**
Got a question on implementing a new feature? [Ask us!](https://developers.ecwid.com/contact) We will be glad to help.

## Get Started Easily

## See Customization Examples

![](https://support.ecwid.com/hc/article_attachments/360001576799/image10.gif)

![](https://support.ecwid.com/hc/article_attachments/360001576779/image12.png)

![](https://support.ecwid.com/hc/article_attachments/360001477960/image14.gif)

## Customize Anything

**Add Custom Payment/Shipping/Discount**
Integrate your preferred payment gateway or shipping carrier. Or provide custom discounts at checkout based on cart contents.
![](https://don16obqbay2c.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/custom-payment-1552055375.png)

**Get Orders or Update Product Stock**
Get access to your store's orders, products, and other store entities to read, update, or delete them without logging into your Control Panel.
![](https://don16obqbay2c.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/rest-api-1552055958.png)

**Save Public and Hidden Data to Orders**
Add new fields to any step of the store checkout process or save hidden information to order with ease.
![](https://don16obqbay2c.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/extra-fields-1551258347.png)

**Customize the Storefront**
Create custom themes, add new features, or restrict the functionality of a storefront with your custom JS and/or CSS file.
![](https://don16obqbay2c.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/storefront-customize-1551262232.png)

**Webhooks About Store Events**
Get notified about store events for different entities — products, categories, orders, abandoned carts, and more.
![](https://don16obqbay2c.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/webhooks-1552056363.png)

**Add Settings to the Control Panel**
Want to change different settings quickly? Build a beautiful native interface that fits nicely into your Control Panel.
![](https://don16obqbay2c.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/native-app-1552057122.png)

## Need Even More?

Mix and match the API features so that they work together — learn about what you can do in the [API Documentation](https://developers.ecwid.com/api-documentation).

### Connect with the Developer Community

Discuss your customizations and store improvements with the members of the Ecwid Developer Community on Slack. Get help in real time from the community or email the Ecwid team to learn about the best practices.

![](https://don16obqbay2c.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/chat-bubble-1552391559.png)

## Frequently Asked Questions

##### **What should I do to get started?**

You just need to [register](https://ecommerce-store.typeform.com/to/GmDik3) your customization with Ecwid.

However, make sure your store is on a paid plan, as the Ecwid API is available for Venture+ plan merchants only.

##### **How do I add more API features to my customization?**

Contact [the Ecwid team](https://developers.ecwid.com/contact) and let us know what API features you want to use. We will make the changes and let you know once it’s done.

If you haven't registered yet, you can do it here: [https://developers.ecwid.com/register](https://developers.ecwid.com/register)

##### **What if I have other questions?**

Feel free to check the [available resources](https://developers.ecwid.com/contact) like Ecwid Help Center, Developer Community on Slack, API Documentation, or the contact form.

## Over to You

Register your customization and start working on new features for your store.
